text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — Medstream renewal is blocked. PO uploaded but currency = EUR, contract/billing in USD. AP is refusing to pay in USD unless vendor entity matches. Also signer listed as Interim COO with no delegation.
Jonah (Sales): Medstream wants seats turned on today; they're stuck on procurement. Priya, can AP reissue PO in USD or confirm FX handling?
Priya (Medstream): Hi all — AP only issues EUR POs. Our treasury will pay in EUR. We can add a payment note mapping EUR->USD at payment time but we can also add vendor mapping doc.
Raul (Finance): We can accept EUR payment if customer includes clear PO currency and we add FX note on the invoice. But vendor entity must match 'Medstream Global Ltd' on contract. What vendor code did they send?
Priya (Medstream): Vendor code MSG-22. PO: https://files.medstream.example/PO-MSG-22.pdf
Maya (CS): PO shows entity 'Medstream EU GmbH' not 'Medstream Global Ltd' — that's the mismatch.
Ben (Legal): For signing we need delegation from the listed signatory. If the signer is "Interim COO - Alex Weber" we need a signed delegation or board minutes. An email from the original authorized signer is acceptable if explicit.
Priya (Medstream): Uploading delegation now. Also can reissue PO naming Medstream Global Ltd — that'll take ~3 hours.
DocuSign Bot: Created envelope env-msg-222 status=sent
Priya (Medstream): Delegation email: "I, Elena Rossi, authorize Alex Weber to sign renewal agreements for Medstream Global Ltd dated 2026-04-03." Attached signed PDF.
Raul (Finance): Got delegation. If they reissue PO to Medstream Global Ltd with vendor code MSG-22 and add "Currency: EUR — payable; Redwood will invoice USD equivalent" in PO note, we can proceed. We'll include FX memo and set invoice due Net30 USD equivalent.
Jonah (Sales): Priya, can AP add that exact PO note please? That should unblock DocuSign.
Priya (Medstream): Done — reissued PO as PO-MSG-22-USDnote.pdf with the note. Link: https://files.medstream.example/PO-MSG-22-USDnote.pdf
Maya (CS): Updating envelope invoice field to "PO-MSG-22-USDnote" and recipient name Alex Weber.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-msg-222 status=completed
Billing Bot: Invoice created referencing PO-MSG-22-USDnote, currency USD, FX memo attached, due 2026-05-04.
Raul (Finance): We'll reconcile FX on receipt; add memo to CRM for accounting.
Maya (CS): Closing loop — renewal cleared after ~4 hrs. Risk: cross-border entities + EUR-only AP workflows add multi-hour delays; recommend capturing vendor legal name + currency preference at renewal outreach. :memo:
Priya (Medstream): Thanks team — appreciate the fast help, seats can be enabled.
Maya (CS): Marking renewal complete in CRM and creating follow-up ticket to add vendor-name checkpoint to renewal checklist.
